name: hbm_su_static_kind2_l4_r4_1016

job.purpose: r4: pin registers share the lane root (r3 gate with a separate pin root: 3,303 pin->lane hops under the cross-root hold reserve, FF hold -111.7 ps, repair stuck at -89.4 on x_b). Regional roots per lane leaf, meeting only at registered seams (r1 gate: one lane root of 32,978 sinks failed the measured >15k insertion/spread rule; s2 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD from per-stage roots): clk = pin registers + stages 0-3+5-7 (~13.2k), clk_sfu stage-4 SFU (~10.8k), clk_ins / clk_ins2 insertion regions 0-1 / 2-3 (21.8k in all), clk_side[5:0] the SIDE pipe six-root partition (41.8k in all); seams = stage-3 registers -> SFU/insertion inputs and their outputs -> stage-5 merge. OT_QMUL4_INCUT, recipe 4 (hold_budget die), sync regional reset (relays sample on the pin root). KIND2 carries the SIDE pipe inside (no side pins), outline 345.6 x 367.2 (87.6k flops, std ~63k um2; r3 first gate: clk_side 41,758 / clk_ins 21,784 sinks on one root each). Pins spread over the FULL W/E/S faces (pin_ranges proportional to bits, balanced placer, <= ~3.4/um); clock entries at the S-face centre beside the register mass (r3 KIND1 gate: N-corner entry, lane root TT insertion 455.9 / spread 131.1 ps). Geometry (coordinator review 1017 item 2): outline 345.6 x 367.2, pins over full faces ({'S': 1.67, 'W': 2.82, 'E': 0.79} pins/um), clock entries at the W-face centre beside the register mass.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL (ot_hbm_su_static_lane_pinreg, PIN_RST=1) already registers every data input, rst_n and every output at the pin; a kit-level flop stage would add a second, unscheduled boundary edge
